Concrete KVM SIGCHLD cause found for https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/3011 release evidence. Scheduler uses host kill(dettid,SIGCHLD) with a virtual guest ID. One bounded frozen-release strace pair proves root guest 3 executes on host namespace TID 1; the first process-child host worker is TID 3. kill(3,SIGCHLD) first succeeds and delivers SI_USER to that host worker, then returns ESRCH after it exits, while virtual parent 3 continues wait4/fstat/write. The diagnostic's parent-exit claim is false for this route. The same signal_guest body is byte-identical at c752, unchanged main7b8 and candidate01cb; saved c752 fork-tree logs already have 6 versus 8 occurrences. Existing strict failures remain failures; this is not a logging-only difference, because ESRCH skips wake_signaled_guest.
The related existing https://github.com/rrnewton/reverie/pull/538 head dd8930e66ad895b40620f2fcd8299d5ad38a082a already provides Guest::queue_child_exit_signal plus explicit accepted/rejected-before-commit/failed-after-commit outcomes and bounded terminal cancellation. Exact immutable definitions and consumers were read. The narrow followup should bridge the actual Hermit scheduler-selected child event to that existing virtual guest operation, preserving CLD metadata, publication ordering, coalescing, blocked/ignored handling and failure outcomes. It must not register host worker IDs, demote logs, or silently suppress signaling. PR538's vector-import and open-standard-descriptor readv blockers remain; no qualification or scheduler review approval is claimed from this interface inspection.
Evidence, source hashes, retained baseline extracts, bounded trace command and proposal: /home/newton/work/dev-hermit/ignored/kvm-parity-20260914-codex/signal-delivery/FINDINGS.md, baseline-proof.json, signal-source-comparison.json, route-probe.json, host-route.strace and pr538/source-bindings.json. One diagnostic pair took 4.014 seconds; no bound fired. No product source, pin, manifest, test, comparator or Git changes were made during this diagnosis.

Post-pin SIGCHLD diagnosis reused the established physical trace and current source rather than rerunning it. At d2d1f8b2 (tree identical to landed Hermit 7089c135) with Reverie a158914e, all six inspected attempts reached comparison: five diverged, and process-chains retry matched. Pipe/process differences extend to InboundSignal scheduling and read ERESTARTSYS; SQLite pairs differ only by two ESRCH INFO messages. The unchanged caller still sends the virtual parent DetTid to host kill. Its host result controls wake_signaled_guest, while the parent remains alive in subsequent records. Hermit has zero queue_child_exit_signal callers. The old strace proves a wrong host recipient; current INFO logs prove the same source branch and scheduling effect but do not identify the current physical recipient or show a real guest handler. This remains the structured Hermit signal caller/lifecycle work, not permission to remove diagnostics or relax comparison. Full findings and binding: ignored/kvm-parity-20260914-codex/next-work/post-pin-sigchld-analysis/FINDINGS.md, report SHA-256 ee14f6cc54fa1b256389796878920333cdad5d7ceb8ee1cf9ca1df7392ad2ac3; binding 790fba25f2dd2b2a95f68f6d8b8add15ae669d29df1c791948a0d08287b88093. No new guest or source change occurred.
Shared-mapping native research separately completed 11 finite controls in 0.396 wall / 0.318 child CPU seconds. MAP_SHARED shrink/regrow and moves preserve original bytes/object identity; successful growth beyond the original object causes guest-native SIGBUS on read/write, including a forked child. Existing KVM shared-fork metadata and classified beyond-object SIGBUS support are absent, so merely adding memfd sharing or zero-filled growth would be incomplete. No current KVM crash or new mmap guest result is claimed. The initial core-dump-suppression setup failed and is retained; PR_SET_DUMPABLE(0) corrected that setup without changing semantic assertions. Root read the full report and verified all 65 artifacts and 12 inputs: next-work/shared-mapping-plan/native-remap/FINDINGS.md under the same evidence root, report 3a7fc22f673ecadc08eb7d09c8b699bc03854143a747400cd5fee501092d429d, binding 7d4c6ba7cb668b3f1d809e23eb25d16bfb3674ac38285f8aadef9c7c10b5184e.
